content.text:
Built **LAST LIGHT**, a complete neon-survival arcade game in `index.html`.

- Survive five waves of enemies, aim with the mouse, fire with click or Space, and move with WASD or the arrow keys.
- Collect drops, manage your hull, and pause with Esc or P.
- Added responsive layouts, sound controls, wave progression, and win/lose screens.

Assumption: the game brief wasn’t present in the repository, so I created a standalone survival game. I verified the menu and gameplay in the browser; `node --check` passes.
